in_sanskrit.name: Subu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Good, Kind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Subu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is good and kind, virtuous and benevolent.

in_tamil.name: Subu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Good, Kind

in_telugu.name: Subu
in_telugu.long_meaning: Subu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who is good and kind, virtuous and benevolent.

in_marathi.name: Subu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is good and kind, virtuous and benevolent.

in_bengali.name: Subu

data.cultural_impact: The name "Subu" is derived from the Sanskrit word "Subha," which translates to 'good,' 'auspicious,' or 'fortunate.' In Hindu culture, names play a crucial role in shaping a child's identity and future. Hearing and being addressed by such a positive name can influence the way people perceive and interact with an individual. The name "Subu" carries a strong cultural significance as it implies harmony, kindness, and positivity, contributing to a respectful and virtuous societal presence.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Subu" holds spiritual significance in Hindu traditions rooted in the belief of the presence of divine qualities in every person. As a spiritual name, it symbolizes virtuous conduct, righteousness, and benevolence, encouraging the pursuit of internal growth and a positive attitude towards life. In Hindu spiritual practices, the name "Subu" can serve as a powerful reminder of the individual's inherent inner goodness, motivating growth along the path of self-realization.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Subu was a Chola king who ruled from 1133 to 1146 AD. The name Subu carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Subu remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Subu from Mumbai, India embodies the meaning of Subu - "Good, Kind". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Subu (सुबु): The name Subu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Subha', meaning auspicious or good fortune. It is a name that signifies positivity and prosperity. The bearer of this name is believed to be blessed with good luck and success in life.
